title: HostCover Lost-Income Settlement: Host Confirmation and Acceptance Tool
content:
An income-loss claim that the claims team has approved on a **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** plan is settled with an income-loss settlement. The claim is for the lost booking income of a host who had to cancel confirmed bookings because damage from a guest's stay made the listing unusable. Lost-income settlements rest on the host's own cancelled bookings, so the host confirms them and accepts the settlement in person, and the figure booked is the income-loss settlement at the moment the host accepts it. Every base condition on paying a claim continues to apply: approval, escalation in time, coverage of the stay, one reimbursement per claim, income loss covered only where the level covers lost income, and no depreciation.

The income-loss settlement is not fixed until the plan's HostCover ledger shows a reimbursement on every approved property-damage claim of the same stay. The income-loss settlement is likewise not fixed until the ledger shows a reimbursement on every approved pet-damage claim of the same stay.

## Capability

`accept_income_loss_settlement_ab094655` records the host's confirmation of the bookings they had to cancel and their acceptance of the lost-income settlement on an approved income-loss claim, and books the settlement as a reimbursement entry on the HostCover ledger of the plan the income-loss claim was filed under. The entry carries the claim, the stay whose damage caused the loss, the loss the claims team verified, the date of acceptance and the settlement amount accepted. The plan's reimbursements grow by that amount, the claim shows as reimbursed in the HostCover ledger, and the money is credited to the host's default payout method by the payout desk.

## Invocation

The host's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_income_loss_settlement_ab094655` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, confirming the cancelled bookings and accepting the settlement.

## Parameters

- `claim_id`: the reference number of the host's approved income-loss claim, as the support agent reads it to the host from the damage-claim records of the HostCover plan. An identifier; no fixed list of values.
- `amount`: the lost-income settlement the host accepts, a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places (cents), exactly as the support agent states it, with no currency symbol. No fixed list of values.

## Receipt

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `status` | `settlement_accepted` when the confirmation was recorded and the settlement booked |
| `protection_event_id` | the reference number of the new ledger entry |
| `claim_id` | the income-loss claim settled |
| `stay_id` | the stay whose damage caused the loss |
| `amount` | the settlement booked in USD, 2 decimal places |
| `posted_date` | the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD |
